jobs.title: Background Investigator
jobs.description: About the Company Founded in 2018 by professors of Yale University and Columbia University, CertiK is a pioneer in blockchain security, utilizing best-in-class AI technology to secure and monitor blockchain protocols and smart contracts. CertiK’s mission is to secure the cyber world. Starting with blockchain, CertiK applies cutting-edge innovations from academia into enterprise, enabling mission-critical applications to be built with security and correctness. CertiK is one of the fastest growing and most trusted companies in blockchain security and has become a true market leader. Our clients include leading projects such as Aave, Polygon, Binance Smart Chain, Yearn, and Chiliz. Our investors include top VCs like Tiger Global, Coatue Management, Shunwei Capital and Hillhouse Capital as well as industry leaders like Coinbase Ventures and Binance. About the Role As a KYC Investigations Analyst, you will deliver CertiK's KYC badge product—the leading private identity verification service for Web3 project teams. You will conduct background interviews and investigations into project teams, diving deep to understand their transparency and risk levels. If the project team completes the screening, your work will culminate in issuing a CertiK KYC badge at an appropriate level that signifies set standards of verification. About You You are a skilled investigator with experience in conducting behavioral interviews while providing excellent customer service. You excel at finding critical information and analyzing it thoroughly. You communicate clearly and effectively, making it easy for others to understand your findings. You are self-motivated, detail-oriented, and can manage multiple tasks independently in a fast-paced environment. You will independently develop, implement and continuously improve the compliance programs, frameworks and processes within your area of responsibility, translating regulatory requirements into practical, risk-based and scalable compliance structures. Working closely with relevant corporate functions and subject-matter owners, you will help embed effective compliance into how our fast-growing international business operates and scales. jobs.title: Senior Partner
jobs.description: About the Role A legal technology company is seeking a Germany-based Senior Partner to help grow an AI-enabled legal practice. You will bring an established client portfolio, continue advising those clients, and work with the team to move recurring legal matters onto AI-assisted workflows. What You'll Do Bring your portable client portfolio to the firm and continue serving those clients. Build relationships with private equity, venture capital, and mid-market clients to support business development. Identify opportunities to provide commercial and compliance services across your client network. Work with the founding team to assess and automate recurring legal matters using AI tools and agent-based workflows. Help shape the firm's growth and represent its legal services in the market. What We're Looking For 12 to 20 or more years of German legal practice, including experience at partner level. A German-qualified Volljurist admitted as a Rechtsanwalt, with native-level German and professional English. A personally held, portable book of business valued at €1 million or more, with a diversified client base and relationships that can transition with you. Experience serving private equity or venture capital clients and their portfolio companies, with recurring work in areas such as commercial contracts, IT and data, corporate matters, or regulatory compliance. Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or legal AI products, and a demonstrated interest in updating legal workflows through automation. Ability to work in Germany and a feasible path to transition your client work. Compensation & Benefits Base salary: €200,000 to €300,000 annually. The role includes meaningful equity.
